device_entry.name: Keysight E4980A 精密LCR表
device_entry.description: 这是一台台式精密LCR表，可在设定交流测试条件和直流偏压下测量电容、电感、电阻及阻抗相关参数。它常用于电子元件、半导体器件和材料样品的C-V表征与阻抗分析。
device_entry.description_en: This is a benchtop precision LCR meter used to measure capacitance, inductance, resistance, and related impedance parameters under defined AC test conditions and DC bias. It is commonly used for C-V characterization and impedance analysis of electronic components, semiconductor devices, and material samples.
